Copywriting Virtual Assistant Support

A copywriting virtual assistant supports research, drafting, editing and publishing from an approved brief and brand guidelines. VOA matches the required writing and content-management experience, then manages the employment and ongoing support around the role.

Find the Right FitSee What You Can Delegate
Article supportWebsite copyProofreading and publishing

Role scope

Build a more consistent content workflow without placing every draft and upload on your core team.

The service starts with the outcomes, recurring work and systems that need coverage. The role is then defined around tasks that can be documented, reviewed and integrated into your existing team.

01

Article drafting

Prepare structured drafts from approved topics, sources, audience guidance and editorial briefs.

02

Website content

Draft or update page copy around supplied positioning, service information and calls to action.

03

Proofreading

Review grammar, consistency, spelling and formatting using the nominated English variant and style guide.

04

Content research

Compile source material, questions and supporting information for review before drafting.

05

Blog administration

Format approved articles, add supplied media and prepare posts in the content-management system.

06

Publishing support

Maintain content calendars, version status, approvals and scheduled publication tasks.

When this role fits

Choose specialised support when the workflow needs more than general administration.

  • Subject-matter experts have ideas but limited drafting time.
  • Website and blog updates are being published inconsistently.
  • Content needs a defined research, review and approval workflow.
  • You need writing support matched to your audience and English style.

Clear role boundaries

Support works best with defined authority and review.

The virtual assistant works from approved briefs and sources. Your business retains responsibility for factual claims, legal or compliance review, brand approval and final publication decisions.

Managed virtual support

The person, onboarding and ongoing support are managed around the role.

VOA covers the staffing relationship so your team can focus on priorities, workflows and quality. The process remains specific to the service, systems and working standards you require.
